text:
Munich’s median asking rent stands at 23.23 €/m², the highest of the 37 cities tracked, and rose 3.0 % year‑on‑year, adding 26.9 % over the last five years. Recent momentum shows a 2.5 % spike in February 2025 and a 1.7 % drop in July 2024, while the market remains tight with 22 days on market and a 34 % share let within a week.  

Affordability is strained: a 60 m² unit costs about 1 394 €/month, pushing the rent‑burden for two residents to 21.9 % and vacancy to a low 1.4 %. The asking premium over existing rents is 80 % (12.89 €/m²).  

The model estimate forecasts median asking rents of 24.44 €/m² in 12 months, ranging from 23.71 €/m² to 24.95 €/m², implying a 5.2 % increase.
